data.title: New Titan, Festive Events & Rewards
data.summary: Gear up for winter battles with Norna and holiday content.
data.meta_description: Gear up for winter battles with Norna and holiday content.
data.content:
Tortuga braces itself as winter descends. Pilots report a chill in the air—but nothing freezes the fire of battle. The December 23 update introduces a new Titan, seasonal rewards, festive pilots, and holiday events that will keep every hangar humming with activity.

Norna: New Assault Titan

The battle for Tortuga heats up with the arrival of Norna, the new FreeCon Assault-class Titan. Born from espionage and forged for domination, Norna excels at breaking enemy lines and controlling the battlefield with overwhelming force.

Norna is now available in the Store and Daily Deals.

New Common Pilot: Rex “Rope” Cole

Something on its chestplate looks familiar, something legendary...

Every war has its entertainers. This winter, Rex Cole takes the stage.

Dressed in Christmas-themed gear and armed with an explosive sense of showmanship, Rex doesn’t just fight battles, he performs them. Where others see cover and caution, Rex sees timing, momentum, and the perfect moment to light up the battlefield.

Pilot Talents

  • Feed Hacker – Your weapons reload 5% faster.
  • Gun Nut – Your shotguns and special weapons deal 4% more damage.
  • Gear Resonator – Using any gear reduces incoming damage by 7% for 5 seconds.
  • Closing the Deal – If your team has more kills than the enemy, your weapons reload 6% faster.
  • Afterparty – Each kill triggers a brief celebratory fireworks effect.

Bold, festive, and unapologetically loud, Rex Cole is ready to bring holiday flair and explosive performance to the front lines.

Note: Common Pilot Rex “Rope” Cole is available only during the holiday period, but may appear in the Store at a later date.

Holiday Events

The holiday spirit isn’t just cosmetic—Tortuga itself celebrates.

Cryo Gift Calendar (Dec 23–29)

Complete daily battles to unwrap festive surprises, revealed day by day.

Intel Discount Event (Dec 23–29)

Discover discounted modules, weapons, and gear for limited-time upgrades.

Solidus Node: Foundry Returns

Step into the industrial shadows for high-stakes, unranked combat.

More events are scheduled to begin at a later date!

Festive Offers

The holidays arrive on Tortuga in style. Winter-themed designs, decals, and stickers await, alongside resource bundles to help Pilots strengthen their hangars before the new year.

Collect the Cold Kills decal and Festive Croc sticker, or grab Warp and Credit offers to get a head start on 2026.

Warp Reals Offers

  • Norna Titan, 12,000 Credits, 75 Intel – 800 Warp Reals
  • Norna Titan, 3,000 Credits, 60 Intel – 500 Warp Reals
  • 1,600 Credits, 50 Intel – 150 Warp Reals
  • Common Pilot Rex “Rope” Cole – 200 Warp Reals
  • Jolly Juggernaut Animated Wrap – 200 Warp Reals

Credit Offers

  • Festive Croc Sticker – 1 Credit
  • Cold Kills Decal – 1 Credit

Note: Common Pilot Rex “Rope” Cole and the Jolly Juggernaut are available only during the holiday period, but may appear in the Store at a later date.

A Signal From The Void

Somewhere in the frozen bandwidth of the Grid, a forgotten transmission flickers back to life. FortEvo intercepts it just long enough for Pilots to act.

Redeem COSMICCLAUS2026 to receive:

  • 3-Day Premium Account
  • 5,000 Salvage
  • Jolly Stocking Sticker

A festive mark left behind by something that still remembers how to give.
